'Env2_LocationC_to_A', 7), (8, 'Env2_A_to_Env1_C', 8),\n   133→        (9, 'Env1_LocationC', 9), (10, 'Env1_LocationC_to_B', 10),\n   134→        (11, 'Env1_LocationB', 11), (12, 'Env1_LocationB_to_A', 12),\n   135→        (13, 'Env1_LocationA', 13), (14, 'Env1_LocationA_to_C', 14),\n   136→    ],\n   137→    'm19': [\n   138→        (1, 'Env1_LocationC', 1), (2, 'Env1_LocationC', 2),\n   139→        (3, 'Env1_LocationC_to_B', 3), (4, 'Env1_LocationB', 4),\n   140→        (5, 'Env1_LocationB_to_A', 5), (6, 'Env1_LocationA', 6),\n   141→        (7, 'Env1_LocationA_to_C', 7), (8, 'Env1_C_to_Env2_A', 8),\n   142→        (9, 'Env2_LocationA', 9), (10, 'Env2_LocationA_to_B', 10),\n   143→        (11, 'Env2_LocationB', 11), (12, 'Env2_LocationB_to_C', 12),\n   144→        (13, 'Env2_LocationC', 13), (14, 'Env2_LocationC_to_A', 14),\n   145→    ],\n   146→}\n   147→\n   148→\n   149→def nansmooth(arr, sigma, axis=-1):\n   150→    \"\"\"Gaussian smoothing that handles NaNs by interpolation.\"\"\"\n   151→    if sigma <= 0:\n   152→        return arr\n   153→    nan_mask = np.isnan(arr)\n   154→    arr_filled = np.copy(arr)\n   155→    arr_filled[nan_mask] = 0\n   156→    smoothed = gaussian_filter1d(arr_filled, sigma, axis=axis)\n   157→    # normalize by the fraction of valid data\n   158→    ones = np.ones_like(arr)\n   159→    ones[nan_mask] = 0\n   160→    norm = gaussian_filter1d(ones, sigma, axis=axis)\n   161→    norm[norm == 0] = 1\n   162→    result = smoothed / norm\n   163→    result[nan_mask] = np.nan\n   164→    return result\n   165→\n   166→\n   167→def compute_dff_and_deconvolve(F, Fneu, trial_starts, trial_ends, frame_rate, n_planes=1):\n   168→    \"\"\"\n   169→    Compute dF/F and deconvolved activity following the paper's pipeline.\n   170→\n   171→    Steps:\n   172→    1. Mask to only include within-trial data (exclude teleport periods)\n   173→    2. Neuropil subtraction: F - 0.7 * Fneu\n   174→    3. Per-trial maximin baseline\n   175→    4. dF/F = (F_corr - baseline) / |baseline|\n   176→    5. Smooth with 2-sample Gaussian\n   177→    6. OASIS deconvolution (tau=0.7)\n   178→    \"\"\"\n   179→    n_cells, n_frames = F.shape\n   180→\n   181→    # Initialize with NaN (teleport periods will remain NaN)\n   182→    f_ = np.full((n_cells, n_frames), np.nan)\n   183→\n   184→    # Copy only within-trial data\n   185→    for start, stop in zip(trial_starts, trial_ends):\n   186→        f_[:, start:stop] = F[:, start:stop]\n   187→\n   188→    f_neu_ = np.full((n_cells, n_frames), np.nan)\n   189→    for start, stop in zip(trial_starts, trial_ends):\n   190→        f_neu_[:, start:stop] = Fneu[:, start:stop]\n   191→\n   192→    # Neuropil subtraction\n   193→    nanmask = ~np.isnan(f_[0, :])\n   194→    f_[:, nanmask] = f_[:, nanmask] - NEU_COEF * f_neu_[:, nanmask]\n   195→\n   196→    # Add back neuropil mean per trial (as in the paper's code)\n   197→    # and compute baseline\n   198→    flow = np.full((n_cells, n_frames), np.nan)\n   199→    for start, stop in zip(trial_starts, trial_ends):\n   200→        # Add back neuropil mean per trial so dF/F values are reasonable\n   201→        f_[:, start:stop] = f_[:, start:stop] + NEU_COEF * np.nanmean(\n   202→            f_neu_[:, start:stop], axis=1, keepdims=True\n   203→        )\n   204→        # Maximin baseline\n   205→        flow[:, start:stop] = nansmooth(f_[:, start:stop], BASELINE_SMOOTH_SIGMA, axis=1)\n   206→        flow[:, start:stop] = minimum_filter1d(flow[:, start:stop], BASELINE_WINDOW, axis=-1)\n   207→        flow[:, start:stop] = maximum_filter1d(flow[:, start:stop], BASELINE_WINDOW, axis=-1)\n   208→\n   209→    # Compute dF/F\n   210→    dff = np.full((n_cells, n_frames), np.nan)\n   211→    dff[:, nanmask] = (f_[:, nanmask] - flow[:, nanmask]) / np.abs(flow[:, nanmask])\n   212→\n   213→    # Smooth dF/F and deconvolve per trial\n   214→    spks = np.full((n_cells, n_frames), np.nan)\n   215→    for start, stop in zip(trial_starts, trial_ends):\n   216→        dff[:, start:stop] = nansmooth(dff[:, start:stop], DFF_SMOOTH_SIGMA, axis=1)\n   217→        spks[:, start:stop] = dcnv.oasis(\n   218→            dff[:, start:stop], 2000, TAU, frame_rate / n_planes\n   219→        )\n   220→\n   221→    return dff, spks\n   222→\n   223→\n   224→def get_reward_zone_for_trial(scene, trial_idx, n_trials, change_trial=30):\n   225→    \"\"\"\n   226→    Determine the reward zone label for a given trial based on the scene name.\n   227→    Returns 'A', 'B', or 'C'.\n   228→    \"\"\"\n   229→    # Single zone sessions\n   230→    if 'LocationA' in scene and '_to_' not in scene and '_to_Env' not in scene.split('Location')[-1]:\n   231→        return 'A'\n   232→    if 'LocationB' in scene and '_to_' not in scene and '_to_Env' not in scene.split('Location')[-1]:\n   233→        return 'B'\n   234→    if 'LocationC' in scene and '_to_' not in scene and '_to_Env' not in scene.split('Location')[-1]:\n   235→        return 'C'\n   236→\n   237→    # Switch sessions - parse zone before and after switch\n   238→    # Handle cross-environment switches like 'Env1_C_to_Env2_B'\n   239→    if '_to_Env' in scene:\n   240→        # e.g. 'Env1_C_to_Env2_B' -> before='C', after='B'\n   241→        parts = scene.split('_to_')\n   242→        before_zone = parts[0].split('_')[-1]  # last char before _to_\n   243→        after_zone = parts[1].split('_')[-1]  # last char\n   244→    elif '_to_' in scene:\n   245→        # e.g. 'Env1_LocationA_to_B' -> before='A', after='B'\n   246→        parts = scene.split('_to_')\n   247→        before_zone = parts[0].split('Location')[-1]\n   248→        after_zone = parts[1]\n   249→    else:\n   250→        # Shouldn't happen\n   251→        return 'A'\n   252→\n   253→    if trial_idx < change_trial:\n   254→        return before_zone\n   255→    else:\n   256→        return after_zone\n   257→\n   258→\n   259→def get_environment(scene):\n   260→    \"\"\"Return 0 for Env1, 1 for Env2.\"\"\"\n   261→    if 'Env2' in scene:\n   262→        # For cross-env switches, the environment changes at the switch\n   263→        if 'Env1' in scene:\n   264→            return None  # mixed - handle per trial\n   265→        return 1\n   266→    return 0\n   267→\n   268→\n   269→def get_environment_per_trial(scene, trial_idx, change_trial=30):\n   270→    \"\"\"Return environment for a specific trial (handles cross-env switches).\"\"\"\n   271→    if '_to_Env' in scene:\n   272→        parts = scene.split('_to_Env')\n   273→        if trial_idx < change_trial:\n   274→            return 0 if 'Env1' in parts[0] else 1\n   275→        else:\n   276→            return 0 if parts[1].startswith('1') else 1\n   277→    elif scene.startswith('Env2'):\n   278→        return 1\n   279→    else:\n   280→        return 0\n   281→\n   282→\n   283→def discretize_distance_to_reward(position, rz_start, rz_end):\n   284→    \"\"\"\n   285→    Compute signed distance from position to nearest point in reward zone,\n   286→    then discretize.\n   287→\n   288→    Distance convention:\n   289→    - Negative = before the zone (position < rz_start)\n   290→    - Zero = inside the zone\n   291→    - Positive = after the zone (position > rz_end)\n   292→\n   293→    Bins:\n   294→    0: < -50 cm\n   295→    1: -50 to -10 cm\n   296→    2: -10 to < 0 cm\n   297→    3: 0 cm (in zone)\n   298→    4: >0 to +10 cm\n   299→    5: +10 to +50 cm\n   300→    6: > +50 cm\n   301→    \"\"\"\n   302→    dist = np.where(\n   303→        position < rz_start, position - rz_start,\n   304→        np.where(position > rz_end, position - rz_end, 0.0)\n   305→    )\n   306→    bins = np.zeros(len(dist), dtype=int)\n   307→    bins[dist < -50] = 0\n   308→    bins[(dist >= -50) & (dist < -10)] = 1\n   309→    bins[(dist >= -10) & (dist < 0)] = 2\n   310→    bins[dist == 0] = 3  # inside zone\n   311→    bins[(dist > 0) & (dist <= 10)] = 4\n   312→    bins[(dist > 10) & (dist <= 50)] = 5\n   313→    bins[dist > 50] = 6\n   314→    return bins\n   315→\n   316→\n   317→def discretize_position(position):\n   318→    \"\"\"Discretize position into 5 equal bins spanning 450 cm.\"\"\"\n   319→    bins = np.clip((position / 90).astype(int), 0, 4)\n   320→    return bins\n   321→\n   322→\n   323→def discretize_speed(speed):\n   324→    \"\"\"Discretize speed into bins.\"\"\"\n   325→    bins = np.zeros(len(speed), dtype=int)\n   326→    bins[speed < 2] = 0\n   327→    bins[(speed >= 2) & (speed < 10)] = 1\n   328→    bins[(speed >= 10) & (speed < 20)] = 2\n   329→    bins[(speed >= 20) & (speed < 40)] = 3\n   330→    bins[speed >= 40] = 4\n   331→    return bins\n   332→\n   333→\n   334→def rz_label_to_idx(label):\n   335→    \"\"\"Map reward zone label to index: A=0, B=1, C=2.\"\"\"\n   336→    return {'A': 0, 'B': 1, 'C': 2}[label]\n   337→\n   338→\n   339→def process_session(nwb_path, subject_id, scene, exp_day):\n   340→    \"\"\"Process a single NWB session and return trial-organized data.\"\"\"\n   341→    print(f\"  Processing {subject_id} day {exp_day} ({scene})\")\n   342→\n   343→    with h5py.File(nwb_path, 'r') as f:\n   344→        bts = f['processing']['behavior']['BehavioralTimeSeries']\n   345→\n   346→        # Load behavioral data\n   347→        position = bts['position']['data'][:]\n   348→        speed = bts['speed']['data'][:]\n   349→        lick = bts['lick']['data'][:]\n   350→        trial_start_signal = bts['trial_start']['data'][:]\n   351→        teleport_signal = bts['teleport']['data'][:]\n   352→        timestamps = bts['position']['timestamps'][:]\n   353→\n   354→        # Load reward events\n   355→        reward_data = bts['Reward']['data'][:]\n   356→        reward_timestamps = bts['Reward']['timestamps'][:]\n   357→\n   358→        # Load neural data - handle multi-plane\n   359→        iscell = f['processing']['ophys']['ImageSegmentation']['PlaneSegmentation']['iscell'][:]\n   360→        imaging_rate = f['acquisition']['TwoPhotonSeries']['imaging_plane']['imaging_rate'][()]\n   361→\n   362→        seg = f['processing']['ophys']['ImageSegmentation']['PlaneSegmentation']\n   363→        if 'planeIdx' in seg:\n   364→            plane_idx = seg['planeIdx'][:]\n   365→            unique_planes = np.unique(plane_idx)\n   366→            n_planes = len(unique_planes)\n   367→        else:\n   368→            plane_idx = np.zeros(iscell.shape[0], dtype=int)\n   369→            n_planes = 1\n   370→\n   371→        # Load and concatenate F/Fneu across planes, maintaining ROI order\n   372→        fluor_group = f['processing']['ophys']['Fluorescence']\n   373→        neuro_group = f['processing']['ophys']['Neuropil']\n   374→        F_list = []\n   375→        Fneu_list = []\n   376→        for p in sorted(unique_planes if n_planes > 1 else [0]):\n   377→            plane_key = f'plane{int(p)}'\n   378→            F_list.append(fluor_group[plane_key]['data'][:].T)  # (n_rois_plane, n_frames)\n   379→            Fneu_list.append(neuro_group[plane_key]['data'][:].T)\n   380→        F = np.concatenate(F_list, axis=0)  # (n_rois_total, n_frames)\n   381→        Fneu = np.concatenate(Fneu_list, axis=0)\n   382→\n   383→    # Ensure behavioral and neural data have same length\n   384→    n_frames = min(len(position), F.shape[1])\n   385→    position = position[:n_frames]\n   386→    speed = speed[:n_frames]\n   387→    lick = lick[:n_frames]\n   388→    trial_start_signal = trial_start_signal[:n_frames]\n   389→    teleport_signal = teleport_signal[:n_frames]\n   390→    timestamps = timestamps[:n_frames]\n   391→    F = F[:, :n_frames]\n   392→    Fneu = Fneu[:, :n_frames]\n   393→\n   394→    # Get frame time\n   395→    frame_time = np.median(np.diff(timestamps))\n   396→\n   397→    # Find trial boundaries\n   398→    tstart_inds = np.where(trial_start_signal > 0)[0]\n   399→    teleport_inds = np.where(teleport_signal > 0)[0]\n   400→\n   401→    n_trials = min(len(tstart_inds), len(teleport_inds))\n   402→    tstart_inds = tstart_inds[:n_trials]\n   403→    teleport_inds = teleport_inds[:n_trials]\n   404→\n   405→    # Ensure each trial_start comes before its teleport\n   406→    valid = []\n   407→    for i in range(n_trials):\n   408→        if tstart_inds[i] < teleport_inds[i]:\n   409→            valid.append(i)\n   410→    tstart_inds = tstart_inds[valid]\n   411→    teleport_inds = teleport_inds[valid]\n   412→    n_trials = len(tstart_inds)\n   413→\n   414→    if n_trials < 2:\n   415→        print(f\"    Skipping: only {n_trials} valid trials\")\n   416→        return None\n   417→\n   418→    # Filter cells by iscell\n   419→    cell_mask = iscell[:, 0] == 1\n   420→    cell_indices = np.where(cell_mask)[0]\n   421→    F_cells = F[cell_indices, :]\n   422→    Fneu_cells = Fneu[cell_indices, :]\n   423→\n   424→    # Compute dF/F and deconvolved activity\n   425→    dff, spks = compute_dff_and_deconvolve(\n   426→        F_cells, Fneu_cells, tstart_inds, teleport_inds, imaging_rate, n_planes\n   427→    )\n   428→\n   429→    # Filter putative interneurons (speed correlation > 0.5 with dF/F)\n   430→    # Compute correlation only on valid (non-NaN) within-trial data\n   431→    valid_mask = ~np.isnan(dff[0, :])\n   432→    speed_valid = speed[valid_mask]\n   433→    keep_neuron = np.ones(dff.shape[0], dtype=bool)\n   434→    for n_idx in range(dff.shape[0]):\n   435→        dff_valid = dff[n_idx, valid_mask]\n   436→        if np.std(dff_valid) > 0 and np.std(speed_valid) > 0:\n   437→            r, _ = pearsonr(dff_valid, speed_valid)\n   438→            if r > INTERNEURON_SPEED_CORR_THR:\n   439→                keep_neuron[n_idx] = False\n   440→\n   441→    n_interneurons = (~keep_neuron).sum()\n   442→    spks = spks[keep_neuron, :]\n   443→    dff = dff[keep_neuron, :]\n   444→    n_neurons = spks.shape[0]\n   445→\n   446→    if n_neurons < 1:\n   447→        print(f\"    Skipping: no neurons after filtering\")\n   448→        return None\n   449→\n   450→    print(f\"    {n_neurons} neurons ({n_interneurons} putative interneurons removed), {n_trials} trials\")\n   451→\n   452→    # Determine 'Env2_LocationB_to_C', 12),\n        (13, 'Env2_LocationC', 13), (14, 'Env2_LocationC_to_A', 14),\n    ],\n}\n\n\ndef nansmooth(arr, sigma, axis=-1):\n    \"\"\"Gaussian smoothing that handles NaNs by interpolation.\"\"\"\n    if sigma <= 0:\n        return arr\n    nan_mask = np.isnan(arr)\n    arr_filled = np.copy(arr)\n    arr_filled[nan_mask] = 0\n    smoothed = gaussian_filter1d(arr_filled, sigma, axis=axis)\n    # normalize by the fraction of valid data\n    ones = np.ones_like(arr)\n    ones[nan_mask] = 0\n    norm = gaussian_filter1d(ones, sigma, axis=axis)\n    norm[norm == 0] = 1\n    result = smoothed / norm\n    result[nan_mask] = np.nan\n    return result\n\n\ndef compute_dff_and_deconvolve(F, Fneu, trial_starts, trial_ends, frame_rate, n_planes=1):\n    \"\"\"\n    Compute dF/F and deconvolved activity following the paper's pipeline.\n\n    Steps:\n    1. Mask to only include within-trial data (exclude teleport periods)\n    2. Neuropil subtraction: F - 0.7 * Fneu\n    3. Per-trial maximin baseline\n    4. dF/F = (F_corr - baseline) / |baseline|\n    5. Smooth with 2-sample Gaussian\n    6. OASIS deconvolution (tau=0.7)\n    \"\"\"\n    n_cells, n_frames = F.shape\n\n    # Initialize with NaN (teleport periods will remain NaN)\n    f_ = np.full((n_cells, n_frames), np.nan)\n\n    # Copy only within-trial data\n    for start, stop in zip(trial_starts, trial_ends):\n        f_[:, start:stop] = F[:, start:stop]\n\n    f_neu_ = np.full((n_cells, n_frames), np.nan)\n    for start, stop in zip(trial_starts, trial_ends):\n        f_neu_[:, start:stop] = Fneu[:, start:stop]\n\n    # Neuropil subtraction\n    nanmask = ~np.isnan(f_[0, :])\n    f_[:, nanmask] = f_[:, nanmask] - NEU_COEF * f_neu_[:, nanmask]\n\n    # Add back neuropil mean per trial (as in the paper's code)\n    # and compute baseline\n    flow = np.full((n_cells, n_frames), np.nan)\n    for start, stop in zip(trial_starts, trial_ends):\n        # Add back neuropil mean per trial so dF/F values are reasonable\n        f_[:, start:stop] = f_[:, start:stop] + NEU_COEF * np.nanmean(\n            f_neu_[:, start:stop], axis=1, keepdims=True\n        )\n        # Maximin baseline\n        flow[:, start:stop] = nansmooth(f_[:, start:stop], BASELINE_SMOOTH_SIGMA, axis=1)\n        flow[:, start:stop] = minimum_filter1d(flow[:, start:stop], BASELINE_WINDOW, axis=-1)\n        flow[:, start:stop] = maximum_filter1d(flow[:, start:stop], BASELINE_WINDOW, axis=-1)\n\n    # Compute dF/F\n    dff = np.full((n_cells, n_frames), np.nan)\n    dff[:, nanmask] = (f_[:, nanmask] - flow[:, nanmask]) / np.abs(flow[:, nanmask])\n\n    # Smooth dF/F and deconvolve per trial\n    spks = np.full((n_cells, n_frames), np.nan)\n    for start, stop in zip(trial_starts, trial_ends):\n        dff[:, start:stop] = nansmooth(dff[:, start:stop], DFF_SMOOTH_SIGMA, axis=1)\n        spks[:, start:stop] = dcnv.oasis(\n            dff[:, start:stop], 2000, TAU, frame_rate / n_planes\n        )\n\n    return dff, spks\n\n\ndef get_reward_zone_for_trial(scene, trial_idx, n_trials, change_trial=30):\n    \"\"\"\n    Determine the reward zone label for a given trial based on the scene name.\n    Returns 'A', 'B', or 'C'.\n    \"\"\"\n    # Single zone sessions\n    if 'LocationA' in scene and '_to_' not in scene and '_to_Env' not in scene.split('Location')[-1]:\n        return 'A'\n    if 'LocationB' in scene and '_to_' not in scene and '_to_Env' not in scene.split('Location')[-1]:\n        return 'B'\n    if 'LocationC' in scene and '_to_' not in scene and '_to_Env' not in scene.split('Location')[-1]:\n        return 'C'\n\n    # Switch sessions - parse zone before and after switch\n    # Handle cross-environment switches like 'Env1_C_to_Env2_B'\n    if '_to_Env' in scene:\n        # e.g. 'Env1_C_to_Env2_B' -> before='C', after='B'\n        parts = scene.split('_to_')\n        before_zone = parts[0].split('_')[-1]  # last char before _to_\n        after_zone = parts[1].split('_')[-1]  # last char\n    elif '_to_' in scene:\n        # e.g. 'Env1_LocationA_to_B' -> before='A', after='B'\n        parts = scene.split('_to_')\n        before_zone = parts[0].split('Location')[-1]\n        after_zone = parts[1]\n    else:\n        # Shouldn't happen\n        return 'A'\n\n    if trial_idx < change_trial:\n        return before_zone\n    else:\n        return after_zone\n\n\ndef get_environment(scene):\n    \"\"\"Return 0 for Env1, 1 for Env2.\"\"\"\n    if 'Env2' in scene:\n        # For cross-env switches, the environment changes at the switch\n        if 'Env1' in scene:\n            return None  # mixed - handle per trial\n        return 1\n    return 0\n\n\ndef get_environment_per_trial(scene, trial_idx, change_trial=30):\n    \"\"\"Return environment for a specific trial (handles cross-env switches).\"\"\"\n    if '_to_Env' in scene:\n        parts = scene.split('_to_Env')\n        if trial_idx < change_trial:\n            return 0 if 'Env1' in parts[0] else 1\n        else:\n            return 0 if parts[1].startswith('1') else 1\n    elif scene.startswith('Env2'):\n        return 1\n    else:\n        return 0\n\n\ndef discretize_distance_to_reward(position, rz_start, rz_end):\n    \"\"\"\n    Compute signed distance from position to nearest point in reward zone,\n    then discretize.\n\n    Distance convention:\n    - Negative = before the zone (position < rz_start)\n    - Zero = inside the zone\n    - Positive = after the zone (position > rz_end)\n\n    Bins:\n    0: < -50 cm\n    1: -50 to -10 cm\n    2: -10 to < 0 cm\n    3: 0 cm (in zone)\n    4: >0 to +10 cm\n    5: +10 to +50 cm\n    6: > +50 cm\n    \"\"\"\n    dist = np.where(\n        position < rz_start, position - rz_start,\n        np.where(position > rz_end, position - rz_end, 0.0)\n    )\n    bins = np.zeros(len(dist), dtype=int)\n    bins[dist < -50] = 0\n    bins[(dist >= -50) & (dist < -10)] = 1\n    bins[(dist >= -10) & (dist < 0)] = 2\n    bins[dist == 0] = 3  # inside zone\n    bins[(dist > 0) & (dist <= 10)] = 4\n    bins[(dist > 10) & (dist <= 50)] = 5\n    bins[dist > 50] = 6\n    return bins\n\n\ndef discretize_position(position):\n    \"\"\"Discretize position into 5 equal bins spanning 450 cm.\"\"\"\n    bins = np.clip((position / 90).astype(int), 0, 4)\n    return bins\n\n\ndef discretize_speed(speed):\n    \"\"\"Discretize speed into bins.\"\"\"\n    bins = np.zeros(len(speed), dtype=int)\n    bins[speed < 2] = 0\n    bins[(speed >= 2) & (speed < 10)] = 1\n    bins[(speed >= 10) & (speed < 20)] = 2\n    bins[(speed >= 20) & (speed < 40)] = 3\n    bins[speed >= 40] = 4\n    return bins\n\n\ndef rz_label_to_idx(label):\n    \"\"\"Map reward zone label to index: A=0, B=1, C=2.\"\"\"\n    return {'A': 0, 'B': 1, 'C': 2}[label]\n\n\ndef process_session(nwb_path, subject_id, scene, exp_day):\n    \"\"\"Process a single NWB session and return trial-organized data.\"\"\"\n    print(f\"  Processing {subject_id} day {exp_day} ({scene})\")\n\n    with h5py.File(nwb_path, 'r') as f:\n        bts = f['processing']['behavior']['BehavioralTimeSeries']\n\n        # Load behavioral data\n        position = bts['position']['data'][:]\n        speed = bts['speed']['data'][:]\n        lick = bts['lick']['data'][:]\n        trial_start_signal = bts['trial_start']['data'][:]\n        teleport_signal = bts['teleport']['data'][:]\n        timestamps = bts['position']['timestamps'][:]\n\n        # Load reward events\n        reward_data = bts['Reward']['data'][:]\n        reward_timestamps = bts['Reward']['timestamps'][:]\n\n        # Load neural data - handle multi-plane\n        iscell = f['processing']['ophys']['ImageSegmentation']['PlaneSegmentation']['iscell'][:]\n        imaging_rate = f['acquisition']['TwoPhotonSeries']['imaging_plane']['imaging_rate'][()]\n\n        seg = f['processing']['ophys']['ImageSegmentation']['PlaneSegmentation']\n        if 'planeIdx' in seg:\n            plane_idx = seg['planeIdx'][:]\n            unique_planes = np.unique(plane_idx)\n            n_planes = len(unique_planes)\n        else:\n            plane_idx = np.zeros(iscell.shape[0], dtype=int)\n            n_planes = 1\n\n        # Load and concatenate F/Fneu across planes, maintaining ROI order\n        fluor_group = f['processing']['ophys']['Fluorescence']\n        neuro_group = f['processing']['ophys']['Neuropil']\n        F_list = []\n        Fneu_list = []\n        for p in sorted(unique_planes if n_planes > 1 else [0]):\n            plane_key = f'plane{int(p)}'\n            F_list.append(fluor_group[plane_key]['data'][:].T)  # (n_rois_plane, n_frames)\n            Fneu_list.append(neuro_group[plane_key]['data'][:].T)\n        F = np.concatenate(F_list, axis=0)  # (n_rois_total, n_frames)\n        Fneu = np.concatenate(Fneu_list, axis=0)\n\n    # Ensure behavioral and neural data have same length\n    n_frames = min(len(position), F.shape[1])\n    position = position[:n_frames]\n    speed = speed[:n_frames]\n    lick = lick[:n_frames]\n    trial_start_signal = trial_start_signal[:n_frames]\n    teleport_signal = teleport_signal[:n_frames]\n    timestamps = timestamps[:n_frames]\n    F = F[:, :n_frames]\n    Fneu = Fneu[:, :n_frames]\n\n    # Get frame time\n    frame_time = np.median(np.diff(timestamps))\n\n    # Find trial boundaries\n    tstart_inds = np.where(trial_start_signal > 0)[0]\n    teleport_inds = np.where(teleport_signal > 0)[0]\n\n    n_trials = min(len(tstart_inds), len(teleport_inds))\n    tstart_inds = tstart_inds[:n_trials]\n    teleport_inds = teleport_inds[:n_trials]\n\n    # Ensure each trial_start comes before its teleport\n    valid = []\n    for i in range(n_trials):\n        if tstart_inds[i] < teleport_inds[i]:\n            valid.append(i)\n    tstart_inds = tstart_inds[valid]\n    teleport_inds = teleport_inds[valid]\n    n_trials = len(tstart_inds)\n\n    if n_trials < 2:\n        print(f\"    Skipping: only {n_trials} valid trials\")\n        return None\n\n    # Filter cells by iscell\n    cell_mask = iscell[:, 0] == 1\n    cell_indices = np.where(cell_mask)[0]\n    F_cells = F[cell_indices, :]\n    Fneu_cells = Fneu[cell_indices, :]\n\n    # Compute dF/F and deconvolved activity\n    dff, spks = compute_dff_and_deconvolve(\n        F_cells, Fneu_cells, tstart_inds, teleport_inds, imaging_rate, n_planes\n    )\n\n    # Filter putative interneurons (speed correlation > 0.5 with dF/F)\n    # Compute correlation only on valid (non-NaN) within-trial data\n    valid_mask = ~np.isnan(dff[0, :])\n    speed_valid = speed[valid_mask]\n    keep_neuron = np.ones(dff.shape[0], dtype=bool)\n    for n_idx in range(dff.shape[0]):\n        dff_valid = dff[n_idx, valid_mask]\n        if np.std(dff_valid) > 0 and np.std(speed_valid) > 0:\n            r, _ = pearsonr(dff_valid, speed_valid)\n            if r > INTERNEURON_SPEED_CORR_THR:\n                keep_neuron[n_idx] = False\n\n    n_interneurons = (~keep_neuron).sum()\n    spks = spks[keep_neuron, :]\n    dff = dff[keep_neuron, :]\n    n_neurons = spks.shape[0]\n\n    if n_neurons < 1:\n        print(f\"    Skipping: no neurons after filtering\")\n        return None\n\n    print(f\"    {n_neurons} neurons ({n_interneurons} putative interneurons removed), {n_trials} trials\")\n\n    # Determine reward delivery per trial\n    # A trial is rewarded if a reward event falls within the trial time window\n    trial_rewarded = np.zeros(n_trials, dtype=int)\n    for i in range(n_trials):\n        t_start_time = timestamps[tstart_inds[i]]\n        t_end_time = timestamps[teleport_inds[i]]\n        # Check if any reward timestamp falls in this trial\n        reward_in_trial = (reward_timestamps >= t_start_time) & (reward_timestamps <= t_end_time)\n        if np.any(reward_in_trial):\n            trial_rewarded[i] = 1\n\n    # Correct lick sensor errors per trial\n    lick_corrected = np.copy(lick)\n    for i in range(n_trials):\n        t0, t1 = tstart_inds[i], teleport_inds[i]\n        trial_licks = lick_corrected[t0:t1]\n        n_frames_trial = len(trial_licks)\n        if n_frames_trial > 0:\n            # Paper: >30% of frames with cumulative lick count > 2\n            frac_high = np.sum(trial_licks > 2) / n_frames_trial\n            if frac_high > 0.3:\n                lick_corrected[t0:t1] = np.nan\n\n    # Build per-trial data\n    neural_trials = []\n    input_trials = []\n    output_trials = []\n\n    for i in range(n_trials):\n        t0, t1 = tstart_inds[i], teleport_inds[i]\n        n_timepoints = t1 - t0\n\n        if n_timepoints < 2:\n            continue\n\n        # Neural activity (deconvolved): (n_neurons, n_timepoints)\n        trial_neural = spks[:, t0:t1]\n        # Replace any remaining NaN with 0\n        trial_neural = np.nan_to_num(trial_neural, nan=0.0)\n\n        # Time from start of trial (seconds)\n        time_from_start = (timestamps[t0:t1] - timestamps[t0])\n\n        # Environment type (per trial)\n        env_type = get_environment_per_trial(scene, i)\n\n        # Trial number\n        trial_number = float(i)\n\n        # Previous trial outcome (0=omission, 1=rewarded)\n        if i == 0:\n            prev_outcome = 1.0  # first trial: no previous, default to rewarded\n        else:\n            prev_outcome = float(trial_rewarded[i - 1])\n\n        # Inputs: (4, n_timepoints) for time_from_start, rest are per-trial\n        trial_input = np.array([\n            time_from_start,\n            np.full(n_timepoints, env_type, dtype=float),\n            np.full(n_timepoints, trial_number, dtype=float),\n            np.full(n_timepoints, prev_outcome, dtype=float),\n        ])\n\n        # Outputs\n        rz_label = get_reward_zone_for_trial(scene, i, n_trials)\n        rz_start, rz_end = REWARD_ZONES[rz_label]\n\n        pos_trial = position[t0:t1]\n        speed_trial = np.abs(speed[t0:t1])  # use absolute speed\n        lick_trial = lick_corrected[t0:t1]\n\n        # Discretize outputs\n        dist_to_rz = discretize_distance_to_reward(pos_trial, rz_start, rz_end)\n        abs_position = discretize_position(pos_trial)\n        speed_binned = discretize_speed(speed_trial)\n        lick_binary = np.where(np.isnan(lick_trial), 0, (lick_trial > 0).astype(int))\n        rz_location = rz_label_to_idx(rz_label)\n        reward_outcome = trial_rewarded[i]\n\n        # Output: (6, n_timepoints) for time-varying, per-trial for constant\n        # Use int type so decoder can use values as category indices\n        trial_output = np.array([\n            dist_to_rz,\n            abs_position,\n            speed_binned,\n            lick_binary,\n            np.full(n_timepoints, rz_location, dtype=int),\n            np.full(n_timepoints, reward_outcome, dtype=int),\n        ], dtype=int)\n\n        neural_trials.append(trial_neural)\n        input_trials.append(trial_input)\n        output_trials.append(trial_output)\n\n    if len(neural_trials) < 2:\n        print(f\"    Skipping: fewer than 2 valid trials after processing\")\n        return None\n\n    return {\n        'neural': neural_trials,\n        'input': input_trials,\n        'output': output_trials,\n        'n_neurons': n_neurons,\n        'subject_id': subject_id,\n        'scene': scene,\n        'exp_day': exp_day,\n        'imaging_rate': imaging_rate,\n        'frame_time': frame_time,\n    }\n\n\ndef main():\n    all_neural = []\n    all_input = []\n    all_output = []\n    all_subject_idx = []\n    all_brain_region_idx = []\n    session_info = []\n\n    subjects = sorted(SESSIONS_META.keys())\n\n    for sub_idx, subject_id in enumerate(subjects):\n        sub_dir = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, f'sub-{subject_id}')\n        if not os.path.exists(sub_dir):\n            print(f\"WARNING: {sub_dir} not found, skipping\")\n            continue\n\n        sessions = SESSIONS_META[subject_id]\n        print(f\"Subject {subject_id}: {len(sessions)} sessions\")\n\n        for ses_num, scene, exp_day in sessions:\n            # NWB session number matches exp_day directly\n            nwb_filename = f'sub-{subject_id}_ses-{exp_day:02d}_behavior+ophys.nwb'\n            nwb_path = os.path.join(sub_dir, nwb_filename)\n\n            if not os.path.exists(nwb_path):\n                print(f\"  WARNING: {nwb_path} not found, skipping\")\n                continue\n\n            result = process_session(nwb_path, subject_id, scene, exp_day)\n            if result is None:\n                continue\n\n            all_neural.append(result['neural'])\n            all_input.append(result['input'])\n            all_output.append(result['output'])\n            all_subject_idx.append(sub_idx)\n            all_brain_region_idx.append(\n                np.zeros(result['n_neurons'], dtype=int)  # all CA1\n            )\n            session_info.append({\n                'subject': subject_id,\n                'exp_day': exp_day,\n                'scene': scene,\n                'imaging_rate': result['imaging_rate'],\n            })\n\n    # Compute median time bin size across all sessions\n    time_bin_sizes = []\n    for info in session_info:\n        time_bin_sizes.append(1000.0 / info['imaging_rate'])\n    median_time_bin = np.median(time_bin_sizes) if time_bin_sizes else 64.5\n\n    data = {\n        'neural': all_neural,\n        'input': all_input,\n        'output': all_output,\n        'subjects': subjects,\n        'subject_idx': np.array(all_subject_idx),\n        'brain_regions': ['CA1'],\n        'brain_region_idx': all_brain_region_idx,\n        'input_names': [\n            'time_from_trial_start',\n            'environment_type',\n            'trial_number',\n            'previous_trial_outcome',\n        ],\n        'output_names': [\n            'distance_to_reward_zone',\n            'absolute_position',\n            'speed',\n            'lick',\n            'reward_zone_location',\n            'reward_outcome',\n        ],\n        'output_values': [\n            ['< -50 cm', '-50 to -10 cm', '-10 to 0 cm', 'in zone', '0 to +10 cm', '+10 to +50 cm', '> +50 cm'],\n            ['0-90 cm', '90-180 cm', '180-270 cm', '270-360 cm', '360-450 cm'],\n            ['< 2 cm/s', '2-10 cm/s', '10-20 cm/s', '20-40 cm/s', '> 40 cm/s'],\n            ['no lick', 'lick'],\n            ['A', 'B', 'C'],\n            ['no reward', 'reward'],\n        ],\n        'metadata': {\n            'task_description': 'Virtual reality hidden reward zone navigation task with reward zone switches across two environments. Mice traverse a 450 cm linear track and lick to receive reward in a hidden 50 cm zone.',\n            'time_bin_size': median_time_bin,\n            'temporal_alignment_event': 'start of trial (first imaging frame after teleport)',\n            'off_start': 0.0,\n            'off_end': None,\n            'session_info': session_info,\n            'track_length_cm': 450,\n            'reward_zones': {'A': [80, 130], 'B': [200, 250], 'C': [320, 370]},\n        },\n    }\n\n    output_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), 'converted_data.pkl')\n    with open(output_path, 'wb') as f:\n        pickle.dump(data, f)\n    print(f\"\\nSaved converted data to {output_path}\")\n    print(f\"  {len(all_neural)} sessions, {len(subjects)} subjects\")\n    for i, sub in enumerate(subjects):\n        n_sess = sum(1 for idx in all_subject_idx if idx == i)\n        print(f\"  {sub}: {n_sess} sessions\")\n\n\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    main()\n","numLines":669,"startLine":1,"totalLines":669}}}

Mask to only include within-trial data (exclude teleport periods)\n    2. Neuropil subtraction: F - 0.7 * Fneu\n    3. Per-trial maximin baseline\n    4. dF/F = (F_corr - baseline) / |baseline|\n    5. Smooth with 2-sample Gaussian\n    6. OASIS deconvolution (tau=0.7)\n    \"\"\"\n    n_cells, n_frames = F.shape\n\n    # Initialize with NaN (teleport periods will remain NaN)\n    f_ = np.full((n_cells, n_frames), np.nan)\n\n    # Copy only within-trial data\n    for start, stop in zip(trial_starts, trial_ends):\n        f_[:, start:stop] = F[:, start:stop]\n\n    f_neu_ = np.full((n_cells, n_frames), np.nan)\n    for start, stop in zip(trial_starts, trial_ends):\n        f_neu_[:, start:stop] = Fneu[:, start:stop]\n\n    # Neuropil subtraction\n    nanmask = ~np.isnan(f_[0, :])\n    f_[:, nanmask] = f_[:, nanmask] - NEU_COEF * f_neu_[:, nanmask]\n\n    # Add back neuropil mean per trial (as in the paper's code)\n    # and compute baseline\n    flow = np.full((n_cells, n_frames), np.nan)\n    for start, stop in zip(trial_starts, trial_ends):\n        # Add back neuropil mean per trial so dF/F values are reasonable\n        f_[:, start:stop] = f_[:, start:stop] + NEU_COEF * np.nanmean(\n            f_neu_[:, start:stop], axis=1, keepdims=True\n        )\n        # Maximin baseline\n        flow[:, start:stop] = nansmooth(f_[:, start:stop], BASELINE_SMOOTH_SIGMA, axis=1)\n        flow[:, start:stop] = minimum_filter1d(flow[:, start:stop], BASELINE_WINDOW, axis=-1)\n        flow[:, start:stop] = maximum_filter1d(flow[:, start:stop], BASELINE_WINDOW, axis=-1)\n\n    # Compute dF/F\n    dff = np.full((n_cells, n_frames), np.nan)\n    dff[:, nanmask] = (f_[:, nanmask] - flow[:, nanmask]) / np.abs(flow[:, nanmask])\n\n    # Smooth dF/F and deconvolve per trial\n    spks = np.full((n_cells, n_frames), np.nan)\n    for start, stop in zip(trial_starts, trial_ends):\n        dff[:, start:stop] = nansmooth(dff[:, start:stop], DFF_SMOOTH_SIGMA, axis=1)\n        spks[:, start:stop] = dcnv.oasis(\n            dff[:, start:stop], 2000, TAU, frame_rate / n_planes\n        )\n\n    return dff, spks\n\n\ndef get_reward_zone_for_trial(scene, trial_idx, n_trials, change_trial=30):\n    \"\"\"\n    Determine the reward zone label for a given trial based on the scene name.\n    Returns 'A', 'B', or 'C'.\n    \"\"\"","numLines":80,"startLine":149,"totalLines":669}}}

This differs from the reference which detects the rising edge of the teleport signal.\n\nii.\n```python\ntstart_inds = np.where(trial_start_signal > 0)[0]\nteleport_inds = np.where(teleport_signal > 0)[0]\n\nn_trials = min(len(tstart_inds), len(teleport_inds))\ntstart_inds = tstart_inds[:n_trials]\nteleport_inds = teleport_inds[:n_trials]\n\nvalid = []\nfor i in range(n_trials):\n    if tstart_inds[i] < teleport_inds[i]:\n        valid.append(i)\n```\n\niii. The AI checked for trial_start and teleport signals in the NWB behavioral data. It validated that trial starts precede trial ends.\n\n## 1-e. How are trials filtered based on quality controls?\n\ni. Trials with fewer than 2 timepoints are excluded. Sessions with fewer than 2 valid trials are skipped entirely.\n\nii.\n```python\nif n_timepoints < 2:\n    continue\n...\nif len(neural_trials) < 2:\n    print(f\"    Skipping: fewer than 2 valid trials after processing\")\n    return None\n```\n\niii. The AI set a minimal threshold of 2 timepoints per trial, much lower than the reference's 50 timepoints.\n\n## 2-a. What variables in the raw data is the `neural` data derived from?\n\ni. Neural data is derived from the raw `Fluorescence` (F) and `Neuropil` (Fneu) traces, loaded per plane from the NWB file. The AI correctly identifies that the NWB `Deconvolved` field is not used by the paper.\n\nii.\n```python\nfluor_group = f['processing']['ophys']['Fluorescence']\nneuro_group = f['processing']['ophys']['Neuropil']\nfor p in sorted(unique_planes if n_planes > 1 else [0]):\n    plane_key = f'plane{int(p)}'\n    F_list.append(fluor_group[plane_key]['data'][:].T)\n    Fneu_list.append(neuro_group[plane_key]['data'][:].T)\nF = np.concatenate(F_list, axis=0)\nFneu = np.concatenate(Fneu_list, axis=0)\n```\n\niii. The AI examined the NWB file structure and the paper's preprocessing code, recognizing that the paper computes its own dF/F and deconvolution from raw F and Fneu.\n\n## 2-b. How is the `neural` data processed?\n\ni. The AI reimplements the paper's dF/F pipeline: (1) mask to within-trial data only, (2) neuropil subtraction with coefficient 0.7, (3) add back per-trial neuropil mean, (4) maximin baseline (Gaussian smooth sigma=15, then 300-sample min then max filter), (5) dF/F = (F_corr - baseline) / |baseline|, (6) smooth with 2-sample Gaussian, (7) OASIS deconvolution with tau=0.7 and frame_rate/n_planes.\n\nKey difference: the AI's `nansmooth` uses `gaussian_filter1d` (1D smoothing), while the reference uses the paper's original `nansmooth` which calls `gaussian_filter` with `[0, 15]` (2D: sigma=0 on cell axis, sigma=15 on time axis). Also, the AI sets NaN weights to 0 in its nansmooth while the reference uses 0.001.\n\nAnother key difference: the AI does NOT handle `keep_teleports`. The reference copies the paper's `teleport_metadata.py` to determine which sessions should include teleport periods in the baseline window, while the AI always excludes them.\n\nii.\n```python\ndef compute_dff_and_deconvolve(F, Fneu, trial_starts, trial_ends, frame_rate, n_planes=1):\n    ...\n    # Copy only within-trial data\n    for start, stop in zip(trial_starts, trial_ends):\n        f_[:, start:stop] = F[:, start:stop]\n    ...\n    # Neuropil subtraction\n    f_[:, nanmask] = f_[:, nanmask] - NEU_COEF * f_neu_[:, nanmask]\n    ...\n    # Add back neuropil mean per trial\n    f_[:, start:stop] = f_[:, start:stop] + NEU_COEF * np.nanmean(\n        f_neu_[:, start:stop], axis=1, keepdims=True)\n    # Maximin baseline\n    flow[:, start:stop] = nansmooth(f_[:, start:stop], BASELINE_SMOOTH_SIGMA, axis=1)\n    flow[:, start:stop] = minimum_filter1d(flow[:, start:stop], BASELINE_WINDOW, axis=-1)\n    flow[:, start:stop] = maximum_filter1d(flow[:, start:stop], BASELINE_WINDOW, axis=-1)\n    ...\n    # dF/F\n    dff[:, nanmask] = (f_[:, nanmask] - flow[:, nanmask]) / np.abs(flow[:, nanmask])\n    ...\n    # Smooth and deconvolve\n    dff[:, start:stop] = nansmooth(dff[:, start:stop], DFF_SMOOTH_SIGMA, axis=1)\n    spks[:, start:stop] = dcnv.oasis(dff[:, start:stop], 2000, TAU, frame_rate / n_planes)\n```\n\niii. The AI examined the paper's preprocessing.py code and replicated the pipeline. It did not discover the `teleport_metadata.py` data about which sessions keep teleports.\n\n## 2-c. How is the `neural` data filtered based on quality controls?\n\ni. Two filters: (1) `iscell` from suite2p manual curation, and (2) putative interneuron removal based on Pearson correlation between dF/F and speed > 0.5. The AI uses `scipy.stats.pearsonr` rather than `np.corrcoef`.\n\nii.\n```python\ncell_mask = iscell[:, 0] == 1\ncell_indices = np.where(cell_mask)[0]\nF_cells = F[cell_indices, :]\nFneu_cells = Fneu[cell_indices, :]\n...\nfor n_idx in range(dff.shape[0]):\n    dff_valid = dff[n_idx, valid_mask]\n    if np.std(dff_valid) > 0 and np.std(speed_valid) > 0:\n        r, _ = pearsonr(dff_valid, speed_valid)\n        if r > INTERNEURON_SPEED_CORR_THR:\n            keep_neuron[n_idx] = False\n```\n\niii. The AI recognized both filters from the paper's Methods section.\n\n## 2-d. How is the per-trial `neural` data aligned to the event described in the `instructions`?\n\ni. Data is aligned to the trial start. The trial's neural data is sliced from `tstart_inds[i]` to `teleport_inds[i]`, so time 0 corresponds to the first frame of the trial. Any remaining NaN values in the neural data are replaced with 0.\n\nii.\n```python\ntrial_neural = spks[:, t0:t1]\ntrial_neural = np.nan_to_num(trial_neural, nan=0.0)\n```\n\niii. The instructions specify alignment to trial start. The NaN replacement with 0 is a defensive measure.\n\n## 2-e. What is the temporal resolution (time bin size) of the converted data? Is any temporal rebinning applied?\n\ni. No rebinning is applied. The time bin size is computed as `1000.0 / imaging_rate` and the median across sessions is used. The AI reads `imaging_rate` from the NWB `imaging_plane` field.\n\nii.\n```python\nimaging_rate = f['acquisition']['TwoPhotonSeries']['imaging_plane']['imaging_rate'][()]\n...\ntime_bin_sizes.append(1000.0 / info['imaging_rate'])\nmedian_time_bin = np.median(time_bin_sizes) if time_bin_sizes else 64.5\n```\n\niii. What processing is involved in computing `output` *Distance to reward zone*?\n\ni. Signed distance is computed: negative when before the zone, 0 when inside, positive when past. Then discretized into 7 bins.\n\nii.\n```python\ndef discretize_distance_to_reward(position, rz_start, rz_end):\n    dist = np.where(\n        position < rz_start, position - rz_start,\n        np.where(position > rz_end, position - rz_end, 0.0)\n    )\n    bins = np.zeros(len(dist), dtype=int)\n    bins[dist < -50] = 0\n    bins[(dist >= -50) & (dist < -10)] = 1\n    bins[(dist >= -10) & (dist < 0)] = 2\n    bins[dist == 0] = 3  # inside zone\n    bins[(dist > 0) & (dist <= 10)] = 4\n    bins[(dist > 10) & (dist <= 50)] = 5\n    bins[dist > 50] = 6\n    return bins\n```\n\niii. The processing matches the instruction specification for distance bins.\n\n## 7-c. Subjects are defined from the hardcoded `SESSIONS_META` dictionary keys, sorted alphabetically. The subject list is `['m11', 'm12', 'm13', 'm14', 'm15', 'm17', 'm18', 'm19', 'm3', 'm4', 'm7']`.\n\nii.\n```python\nsubjects = sorted(SESSIONS_META.keys())\n```\n\niii. The AI derived subject IDs from the paper's session metadata rather than discovering them from directory names.\n\n## 1-c. How are the data split into sessions?\n\ni. Each NWB file corresponds to one session. Sessions are enumerated from the hardcoded `SESSIONS_META` dictionary for each subject.\n\nii.\n```python\nsessions = SESSIONS_META[subject_id]\nfor ses_num, scene, exp_day in sessions:\n    nwb_filename = f'sub-{subject_id}_ses-{exp_day:02d}_behavior+ophys.nwb'\n```\n\niii. The AI hardcoded session metadata from the paper's `sessions_dict.py` to map session numbers to scene names and experiment days.\n\n## 1-d. How are the data split into trials?\n\ni. Trial starts are identified where `trial_start_signal > 0` and trial ends where `teleport_signal > 0`. The AI uses `np.where(teleport_signal > 0)[0]` to find all positive teleport frames, then takes the first `min(n_starts, n_teleports)` of each, and validates that each start comes before its paired end. This differs from the reference which detects the rising edge of the teleport signal.\n\nii.\n```python\ntstart_inds = np.where(trial_start_signal > 0)[0]\nteleport_inds = np.where(teleport_signal > 0)[0]\n\nn_trials = min(len(tstart_inds), len(teleport_inds))\ntstart_inds = tstart_inds[:n_trials]\nteleport_inds = teleport_inds[:n_trials]\n\nvalid = []\nfor i in range(n_trials):\n    if tstart_inds[i] < teleport_inds[i]:\n        valid.append(i)\n```\n\niii. The AI checked for trial_start and teleport signals in the NWB behavioral data. It validated that trial starts precede trial ends.\n\n## 1-e. How are trials filtered based on quality controls?\n\ni. Trials with fewer than 2 timepoints are excluded. Sessions with fewer than 2 valid trials are skipped entirely.\n\nii.\n```python\nif n_timepoints < 2:\n    continue\n...\nif len(neural_trials) < 2:\n    print(f\"    Skipping: fewer than 2 valid trials after processing\")\n    return None\n```\n\niii. The AI set a minimal threshold of 2 timepoints per trial, much lower than the reference's 50 timepoints.\n\n## 2-a. What variables in the raw data is the `neural` data derived from?\n\ni. Neural data is derived from the raw `Fluorescence` (F) and `Neuropil` (Fneu) traces, loaded per plane from the NWB file. The AI correctly identifies that the NWB `Deconvolved` field is not used by the paper.\n\nii.\n```python\nfluor_group = f['processing']['ophys']['Fluorescence']\nneuro_group = f['processing']['ophys']['Neuropil']\nfor p in sorted(unique_planes if n_planes > 1 else [0]):\n    plane_key = f'plane{int(p)}'\n    F_list.append(fluor_group[plane_key]['data'][:].T)\n    Fneu_list.append(neuro_group[plane_key]['data'][:].T)\nF = np.concatenate(F_list, axis=0)\nFneu = np.concatenate(Fneu_list, axis=0)\n```\n\niii. The AI examined the NWB file structure and the paper's preprocessing code, recognizing that the paper computes its own dF/F and deconvolution from raw F and Fneu.\n\n## 2-b. How is the `neural` data processed?\n\ni. The AI reimplements the paper's dF/F pipeline: (1) mask to within-trial data only, (2) neuropil subtraction with coefficient 0.7, (3) add back per-trial neuropil mean, (4) maximin baseline (Gaussian smooth sigma=15, then 300-sample min then max filter), (5) dF/F = (F_corr - baseline) / |baseline|, (6) smooth with 2-sample Gaussian, (7) OASIS deconvolution with tau=0.7 and frame_rate/n_planes.\n\nKey difference: the AI's `nansmooth` uses `gaussian_filter1d` (1D smoothing), while the reference uses the paper's original `nansmooth` which calls `gaussian_filter` with `[0, 15]` (2D: sigma=0 on cell axis, sigma=15 on time axis). Also, the AI sets NaN weights to 0 in its nansmooth while the reference uses 0.001.\n\nAnother key difference: the AI does NOT handle `keep_teleports`. The reference copies the paper's `teleport_metadata.py` to determine which sessions should include teleport periods in the baseline window, while the AI always excludes them.\n\nii.\n```python\ndef compute_dff_and_deconvolve(F, Fneu, trial_starts, trial_ends, frame_rate, n_planes=1):\n    ...\n    # Copy only within-trial data\n    for start, stop in zip(trial_starts, trial_ends):\n        f_[:, start:stop] = F[:, start:stop]\n    ...\n    # Neuropil subtraction\n    f_[:, nanmask] = f_[:, nanmask] - NEU_COEF * f_neu_[:, nanmask]\n    ...\n    # Add back neuropil mean per trial\n    f_[:, start:stop] = f_[:, start:stop] + NEU_COEF * np.nanmean(\n        f_neu_[:, start:stop], axis=1, keepdims=True)\n    # Maximin baseline\n    flow[:, start:stop] = nansmooth(f_[:, start:stop], BASELINE_SMOOTH_SIGMA, axis=1)\n    flow[:, start:stop] = minimum_filter1d(flow[:, start:stop], BASELINE_WINDOW, axis=-1)\n    flow[:, start:stop] = maximum_filter1d(flow[:, start:stop], BASELINE_WINDOW, axis=-1)\n    ...\n    # dF/F\n    dff[:, nanmask] = (f_[:, nanmask] - flow[:, nanmask]) / np.abs(flow[:, nanmask])\n    ...\n    # Smooth and deconvolve\n    dff[:, start:stop] = nansmooth(dff[:, start:stop], DFF_SMOOTH_SIGMA, axis=1)\n    spks[:, start:stop] = dcnv.oasis(dff[:, start:stop], 2000, TAU, frame_rate / n_planes)\n```\n\niii. The AI examined the paper's preprocessing.py code and replicated the pipeline. It did not discover the `teleport_metadata.py` data about which sessions keep teleports.\n\n## 2-c. How is the `neural` data filtered based on quality controls?\n\ni. Two filters: (1) `iscell` from suite2p manual curation, and (2) putative interneuron removal based on Pearson correlation between dF/F and speed > 0.5. The AI uses `scipy.stats.pearsonr` rather than `np.corrcoef`.\n\nii.\n```python\ncell_mask = iscell[:, 0] == 1\ncell_indices = np.where(cell_mask)[0]\nF_cells = F[cell_indices, :]\nFneu_cells = Fneu[cell_indices, :]\n...\nfor n_idx in range(dff.shape[0]):\n    dff_valid = dff[n_idx, valid_mask]\n    if np.std(dff_valid) > 0 and np.std(speed_valid) > 0:\n        r, _ = pearsonr(dff_valid, speed_valid)\n        if r > INTERNEURON_SPEED_CORR_THR:\n            keep_neuron[n_idx] = False\n```\n\niii. The AI recognized both filters from the paper's Methods section.\n\n## 2-d. How is the per-trial `neural` data aligned to the event described in the `instructions`?\n\ni. Data is aligned to the trial start. The trial's neural data is sliced from `tstart_inds[i]` to `teleport_inds[i]`, so time 0 corresponds to the first frame of the trial. Any remaining NaN values in the neural data are replaced with 0.\n\nii.\n```python\ntrial_neural = spks[:, t0:t1]\ntrial_neural = np.nan_to_num(trial_neural, nan=0.0)\n```\n\niii. The instructions specify alignment to trial start. The NaN replacement with 0 is a defensive measure.\n\n## 2-e. What is the temporal resolution (time bin size) of the converted data? Is any temporal rebinning applied?\n\ni. No rebinning is applied. The time bin size is computed as `1000.0 / imaging_rate` and the median across sessions is used. The AI reads `imaging_rate` from the NWB `imaging_plane` field.\n\nii.\n```python\nimaging_rate = f['acquisition']['TwoPhotonSeries']['imaging_plane']['imaging_rate'][()]\n...\ntime_bin_sizes.append(1000.0 / info['imaging_rate'])\nmedian_time_bin = np.median(time_bin_sizes) if time_bin_sizes else 64.5\n```\n\niii. The AI uses the imaging_rate field directly. For multi-plane sessions, the `imaging_rate` field may represent the per-plane rate rather than the scanner rate, leading to a potentially different time bin size calculation compared to the reference.\n\n## 3-a. What processing is involved in computing `output` *Distance to reward zone*?\n\ni. Signed distance is computed: negative when before the zone, 0 when inside, positive when past. Then discretized into 7 bins.\n\nii.\n```python\ndef discretize_distance_to_reward(position, rz_start, rz_end):\n    dist = np.where(\n        position < rz_start, position - rz_start,\n        np.where(position > rz_end, position - rz_end, 0.0)\n    )\n    bins = np.zeros(len(dist), dtype=int)\n    bins[dist < -50] = 0\n    bins[(dist >= -50) & (dist < -10)] = 1\n    bins[(dist >= -10) & (dist < 0)] = 2\n    bins[dist == 0] = 3  # inside zone\n    bins[(dist > 0) & (dist <= 10)] = 4\n    bins[(dist > 10) & (dist <= 50)] = 5\n    bins[dist > 50] = 6\n    return bins\n```\n\niii. The processing matches the instruction specification for distance bins.\n\n## 7-c. How is `output` *Distance to reward zone* thresholded into categories?\n\ni. 7 bins using explicit conditional logic: `< -50`, `-50 to -10`, `-10 to 0`, `== 0` (in zone), `0 to 10`, `10 to 50`, `> 50`.\n\nii. The AI used integer division by bin width. This produces slightly different bin boundaries than `np.digitize` with `[-inf, 90, 180, 270, 360, inf]`: for example, a position of exactly 90 would be bin 1 with both approaches, but negative positions would be clipped to 0 rather than falling in a separate bin.\n\n## 8-c. This requires examining the provided paper, code, and data to understand how the data is formatted and processed, and determine how to balance this with the requirements of the new downstream analysis.\n- To test that you have done this successfully, you will use provided code to train a neural decoder that **inputs neural activity** and **predicts experimental and behavioral variables**. \n- We will assess your work in two ways. First, statistics of the converted data and decoder accuracy will be compared to those of an expert-written solution. Second, each decision you make about how to load, filter, process, align, and save the data will be compared with the decision made by an expert. A decision that differs from the expert's is acceptable if it is equally well justified; decisions that are poorly justified will be flagged as concerning or incorrect.\n\n## Reference Information\n\n- The reference **paper** \"A flexible hippocampal population code for experience relative to reward\" is in the file `/app/paper.pdf`.\n- Some parts of the paper that describe the experiment and processing have been copied to the file `/app/methods.txt`. \n- **Code** from the paper are in the directory `/app/code`.\n- **Data** from the paper are in the directory `/app/data`.\n\n## Decoder Task\n\nTemporally align based on start of the trial. \n\n### Decoder Inputs:\n- Time from start of trial in seconds (continuous, time-varying)\n- Environment type (binary, ENV1 vs ENV2, per trial)\n- Trial number (continuous, per trial)\n- Previous trial outcome (binary, omitted = 0, rewarded = 1, per trial)\n\n### Decoder Outputs\n- Distance to any location in the reward zone, time-varying. Discretization bins:\n  - 0:  < -50 cm\n  - 1: -50 to -10 cm\n  - 2: -10 cm to < 0 cm\n  - 3: 0 cm\n  - 4: >0 cm to +10 cm\n  - 5: +10 to +50 cm\n  - 6: > +50 cm\n- Absolute position in corridor, time-varying. Discretized into 5 equal-sized bins spanning the 450 cm track:\n  - 0: < 90 cm\n  - 1: 90 to 180 cm\n  - 2: 180 to 270 cm\n  - 3: 270 to 360 cm\n  - 4: > 360 cm\n- Speed, time-varying. Discretized into bins:\n  - 0: < 2 cm/s\n  - 1: 2-10 cm/s\n  - 2: 10-20 cm/s\n  - 3: 20-40 cm/s\n  - 4: > 40 cm/s\n- Lick, time-varying. 0 = no, 1 = yes\n- Reward zone location, per-trial. 0 = A, 1 = B, 2 = C\n- Reward outcome, per-trial. 0 = no, 1 = yes\n\n## Target Data Format\n\n- Save the full converted dataset to the pickle file `/app/converted_data.pkl`.\n- All datasets must be converted into the following Python dictionary structure:\n\n```python\ndata = {\n    'neural': [  # list of sessions\n        [  # list of trials for session 1\n            neuron_by_time_matrix,  # shape: (n_neurons, n_timepoints)\n            neuron_by_time_matrix,  # trial 2\n            ...\n        ],\n        [  # list of trials for session 2\n            ...\n        ],\n        ...\n    ],\n\n    'input': [  # list of sessions\n        [  # list of trials for session 1\n            input_data,  # stimulus/task variables, shape: (n_input, n_timepoints) or (n_input)\n            ...\n        ],\n        ...\n    ],\n\n    'output': [  # list of sessions\n        [  # list of trials for session 1\n            output_data,  # behavioral response, shape (n_output, n_timepoints) or (n_output)\n            ...\n        ],\n        ...\n    ],\n\n    'subjects': list of str, # ids of all subjects, length n_subjects\n    'subject_idx': shape (n_sessions,), # index into subjects for each session\n\n    'brain_regions': list of str, # names of the brain regions recorded from, e.g. ALM, V1\n    'brain_region_idx': [ # list of sessions\n        neuron_region_idx, # shape: (n_neurons,)\n    ], # index into `brain_regions` for each neuron\n\n    'input_names': list of str, # names for each input, of length n_input\n    'output_names': list of str, # names of each output, of length n_output\n    'output_values': [ # list of length n_output\n        [ output_val0, ... ], # list of str of length d_output[0], name of each output value\n        ...\n    ],\n\n    'metadata': {\n        'task_description': str, # description of output tasks\n        'time_bin_size': float, # length of time bin in ms\n        'temporal_alignment_event': str, # description of alignment event\n        'off_start': float or None, # signed time from alignment event to start of trial in seconds, None if N/A\n        'off_end': float or None, # signed time from alignment event to end of trial in seconds, None if N/A\n        ...\n    }\n}\n```\n\n### Key Format Requirements\n\n- **neural**: Neural activity data (e.g., firing rates, spike counts) organized by session and trial\n  - Dimensions: (n_neurons, n_timepoints) for each trial.\n  - Time bins should be the same size for all trials and sessions. \n  - There needs to be at least two trials within each session in order to evaluate the decoder performance.\n\n- **input**: Variables that serve as inputs **to the decoder**\n  - These are **decoder inputs**. They could be task inputs to the animal, but inputs to the animal can also be decoder outputs.\n  - Examples: time from an aligning signal, stimulus characteristics, our animal behavior such as:\n    - visual: contrast, position, orientation\n    - audio: frequency, amplitude\n    - behavior: running speed, pupil size\n  - Dimensions: (d_input, n_timepoints) for each trial. \n  - Should capture all relevant contextual information for the decoder\n  - If an input is a time such as onset of some stimulus, represent it as a binary time series. \n\n- **output**: Variables to be decoded/predicted from neural activity\n  - These are what we want the decoder to **predict**. They could be the animal's output behavior or properties of the stimulus.\n  - Output variables must be **categorical**, i.e. discrete rather than continuous. If a variable is not discrete, follow instructions from Decoder Task to discretize it. \n  - Examples: stimulus properties (contrast, orientation), choice (left/right), reaction time, position\n  - Can be time-varying or discrete values per trial. If at all possible, make it time-varying\n  - If an output is a time such as when a behavior occurred, represent it as a binary time series. \n\n- **subjects**: List of names of all unique subjects (mice).\n- **subject_idx**: Index into subjects for each session.\n  - Order should match order of sessions in `neural`, etc.\n\n- **brain_regions**: List of names of all brain regions recorded from.\n- **brain_region_idx**: Index into brain_regions for each neuron in each session.\n\n- **input_names**: Names of each input variable.\n  - Order should match order of `input` dimensions. \n\n- **output_names**: Names of each output variable.\n  - Order should match order of `output` dimensions.\n- **output_values**: Names of each output value for each output variable.\n  - Order should match categorical `output` values.\n\n- **metadata**: Descriptive information. \n  - `task_description`: Concise description of the task\n  - `temporal_alignment_event`: Concise description of temporal alignment event\n  - `off_start`: Signed time from alignment event to start of trial. Negative means before event, positive after. \n  - `off_end`: Signed time from alignment event to end of trial\n  - Add other relevant fields, e.g. `session_info`\n\n## Decoder Reference\n\n- Run this script with `python /app/train_decoder.py <data_file_path>` to validate.\n- Optional arguments:\n  - `--verify-only`: Only verify data format and print summary, then exit (does not train decoder).\n  - `--plot-samples`: Plot sample trials from data and save to png files.\n  - `--cpu`: Force torch to use CPU only (use if GPU runs out of memory).\n\n### Purpose\n\nThese functions will be used during the validation phase to ensure:\n1. Data structure is correct - will report errors and warnings to stdout. \n2. Dimensions are consistent - will report errors and warnings to stdout. \n3. Values are sensible - will report errors and warnings to stdout. \n4. Decoder can successfully train and predict\n5. Poor performance indicates data formatting issues that need investigation\n\n### Consistency requirements\n\nYour processing and formatting must **match the reference paper and code** with respect to:\n- Loading of data\n- Temporal alignment of different time series streams (neural, inputs, outputs)\n- Processing of neural, input, and output data streams\n- Curation of data: filtering of low-quality neurons, trials, sessions, and mice.\n\nDiscrepancies are only allowed if required by the Decoder Input and Decoder Output specifications above, or the task of training a neural decoder. During testing, a reference copy of `/app/train_decoder.py` will be run on your converted data. Data statistics and decoder accuracy will be compared to those achieved by human-written conversion code.\n\n## Success Criteria\n\nA successful conversion should:\n1. All required files must be created:\n  - `/app/convert_data.py`\n  - `/app/converted_data.pkl`\n2. Match the target data structure exactly\n3. Have consistent dimensions across trials/sessions\n4. Include all relevant data from the source\n5. Match information provided in the reference texts, code, and these instructions\n6. Outputs must match expert-written conversion code in:\n  - Dataset size and distribution statistics\n  - Decoder accuracy\n7. Each decision about how to load, filter, process, align, and save the data will be compared with the decision made by an expert. 'Env2_LocationB_to_C', 12),\n        (13, 'Env2_LocationC', 13), (14, 'Env2_LocationC_to_A', 14),\n    ],\n}\n\n\ndef nansmooth(arr, sigma, axis=-1):\n    \"\"\"Gaussian smoothing that handles NaNs by interpolation.\"\"\"\n    if sigma <= 0:\n        return arr\n    nan_mask = np.isnan(arr)\n    arr_filled = np.copy(arr)\n    arr_filled[nan_mask] = 0\n    smoothed = gaussian_filter1d(arr_filled, sigma, axis=axis)\n    # normalize by the fraction of valid data\n    ones = np.ones_like(arr)\n    ones[nan_mask] = 0\n    norm = gaussian_filter1d(ones, sigma, axis=axis)\n    norm[norm == 0] = 1\n    result = smoothed / norm\n    result[nan_mask] = np.nan\n    return result\n\n\ndef compute_dff_and_deconvolve(F, Fneu, trial_starts, trial_ends, frame_rate, n_planes=1):\n    \"\"\"\n    Compute dF/F and deconvolved activity following the paper's pipeline.\n\n    Steps:\n    1. Mask to only include within-trial data (exclude teleport periods)\n    2. Neuropil subtraction: F - 0.7 * Fneu\n    3. Per-trial maximin baseline\n    4. dF/F = (F_corr - baseline) / |baseline|\n    5. Smooth with 2-sample Gaussian\n    6. OASIS deconvolution (tau=0.7)\n    \"\"\"\n    n_cells, n_frames = F.shape\n\n    # Initialize with NaN (teleport periods will remain NaN)\n    f_ = np.full((n_cells, n_frames), np.nan)\n\n    # Copy only within-trial data\n    for start, stop in zip(trial_starts, trial_ends):\n        f_[:, start:stop] = F[:, start:stop]\n\n    f_neu_ = np.full((n_cells, n_frames), np.nan)\n    for start, stop in zip(trial_starts, trial_ends):\n        f_neu_[:, start:stop] = Fneu[:, start:stop]\n\n    # Neuropil subtraction\n    nanmask = ~np.isnan(f_[0, :])\n    f_[:, nanmask] = f_[:, nanmask] - NEU_COEF * f_neu_[:, nanmask]\n\n    # Add back neuropil mean per trial (as in the paper's code)\n    # and compute baseline\n    flow = np.full((n_cells, n_frames), np.nan)\n    for start, stop in zip(trial_starts, trial_ends):\n        # Add back neuropil mean per trial so dF/F values are reasonable\n        f_[:, start:stop] = f_[:, start:stop] + NEU_COEF * np.nanmean(\n            f_neu_[:, start:stop], axis=1, keepdims=True\n        )\n        # Maximin baseline\n        flow[:, start:stop] = nansmooth(f_[:, start:stop], BASELINE_SMOOTH_SIGMA, axis=1)\n        flow[:, start:stop] = minimum_filter1d(flow[:, start:stop], BASELINE_WINDOW, axis=-1)\n        flow[:, start:stop] = maximum_filter1d(flow[:, start:stop], BASELINE_WINDOW, axis=-1)\n\n    # Compute dF/F\n    dff = np.full((n_cells, n_frames), np.nan)\n    dff[:, nanmask] = (f_[:, nanmask] - flow[:, nanmask]) / np.abs(flow[:, nanmask])\n\n    # Smooth dF/F and deconvolve per trial\n    spks = np.full((n_cells, n_frames), np.nan)\n    for start, stop in zip(trial_starts, trial_ends):\n        dff[:, start:stop] = nansmooth(dff[:, start:stop], DFF_SMOOTH_SIGMA, axis=1)\n        spks[:, start:stop] = dcnv.oasis(\n            dff[:, start:stop], 2000, TAU, frame_rate / n_planes\n        )\n\n    return dff, spks\n\n\ndef get_reward_zone_for_trial(scene, trial_idx, n_trials, change_trial=30):\n    \"\"\"\n    Determine the reward zone label for a given trial based on the scene name.\n    Returns 'A', 'B', or 'C'.\n    \"\"\"\n    # Single zone sessions\n    if 'LocationA' in scene and '_to_' not in scene and '_to_Env' not in scene.split('Location')[-1]:\n        return 'A'\n    if 'LocationB' in scene and '_to_' not in scene and '_to_Env' not in scene.split('Location')[-1]:\n        return 'B'\n    if 'LocationC' in scene and '_to_' not in scene and '_to_Env' not in scene.split('Location')[-1]:\n        return 'C'\n\n    # Switch sessions - parse zone before and after switch\n    # Handle cross-environment switches like 'Env1_C_to_Env2_B'\n    if '_to_Env' in scene:\n        # e.g. 'Env1_C_to_Env2_B' -> before='C', after='B'\n        parts = scene.split('_to_')\n        before_zone = parts[0].split('_')[-1]  # last char before _to_\n        after_zone = parts[1].split('_')[-1]  # last char\n    elif '_to_' in scene:\n        # e.g. 'Env1_LocationA_to_B' -> before='A', after='B'\n        parts = scene.split('_to_')\n        before_zone = parts[0].split('Location')[-1]\n        after_zone = parts[1]\n    else:\n        # Shouldn't happen\n        return 'A'\n\n    if trial_idx < change_trial:\n        return before_zone\n    else:\n        return after_zone\n\n\ndef get_environment(scene):\n    \"\"\"Return 0 for Env1, 1 for Env2.\"\"\"\n","exit_code":0,"status":"completed"}}

extrapolate to get a higher value for the last bin edge\n    bin_centers = (bin_edges_plot[:-1] + bin_edges_plot[1:]) / 2\n    return bin_centers\n    \ndef compute_distance_to_reward_zone(position_curr, reward_zone_curr):\n    ntimepoints = len(position_curr)\n    reward_zone_range = reward_zone_dict[reward_zone_curr]\n    distance_to_reward_zone = np.zeros(ntimepoints)\n    idx_before_zone = position_curr < reward_zone_range[0]\n    distance_to_reward_zone[idx_before_zone] = position_curr[idx_before_zone] - reward_zone_range[0] # Every step of dff is per-cell --\n        # its only cross-cell operation is a Gaussian with sigma 0 on the cell axis -- so this is\n        # numerically identical to subsetting afterwards, on a third of the memory.\n        fluorescence.append(fluorescence_curr[:,iscell])\n        neuropil.append(neuropil_curr[:,iscell])\n    T = fluorescence[0].shape[0]\n    # agent\nExecuted Read toolu_01LuxyAJF2SNsg4ukhXeXgC6\nTOOLS: ['Read']\nOBS: 1→# Overview\n     2→\n     3→To dissociate reward from other sensory stimuli and observe how hippocampal activity related to rewards evolves with experience, we performed two-photon (2P) calcium imaging of CA1 neurons expressing GCaMP7f in head-fixed mice learning a virtual reality (VR) navigation task (Fig. 1a–c). VR provided tight control over sensory stimuli and the animal’s trajectory, allowing us to observe neuronal remapping in relation to distant rewards, a phenomenon potentially less visible in freely moving scenarios. Furthermore, the task included multiple updates to a hidden reward zone across two environments, allowing us to dissociate spatially driven and reward-driven remapping. Imaging began on day 1 of task acquisition, in which animals traversed a unidirectional 450 cm virtual linear track (for example, Environment 1 (ENV 1)) with a hidden 50 cm reward zone where sucrose water was delivered operantly for licking (Fig. 1d,e). On day 3, the reward zone was moved within a ‘switch’ session to a new track location, signaled by automatic reward delivery on the first ten post-switch trials only if the mouse failed to lick in the new zone. switching to encourage stable assignments\n    zone_names = sorted(reward_zone_dict.keys())\n    n_states = len(zone_names)\n    zone_ranges = np.array([reward_zone_dict[z] for z in zone_names])  # (n_states, 2)\n    pstay = .9\n    sigma = 10.0  # std dev for Gaussian emission on zone distance\n\n    # transition log-probabilities\n    log_trans = np.full((n_states, n_states), np.log((1 - pstay) / (n_states - 1)))\n    np.fill_diagonal(log_trans, np.log(pstay))\n\n    results = {}\n\n    for mouse_id, positions in reward_zone_positions.items():\n        n_trials = positions.shape[0]\n        startpoints = positions[:,0] # use the start point as it looks cleaner\n        valid = ~np.isnan(startpoints)\n\n        # emission log-probabilities: Gaussian penalty based on distance to zone range\n        # distance is 0 if inside [lo, hi], otherwise distance to nearest edge\n        # for NaN trials, uniform emission (all zeros) so assignment is driven by transitions\n        log_emission = np.zeros((n_trials, n_states))\n        dist = np.maximum(zone_ranges[None, :, 0] - startpoints[valid, None],\n                          startpoints[valid, None] - zone_ranges[None, :, 1]) # negative if inside the zone, positive if outside\n        dist = np.maximum(dist, 0)\n        log_emission[valid] = -0.5 * (dist / sigma) ** 2\n\n        # viterbi forward pass\n        log_delta = np.zeros((n_trials, n_states))\n        psi = np.zeros((n_trials, n_states), dtype=int)\n        log_delta[0] = log_emission[0]  # uniform prior\n        for t in range(1, n_trials):\n            for k in range(n_states):\n                scores = log_delta[t - 1] + log_trans[:, k]\n                psi[t, k] = np.argmax(scores)\n                log_delta[t, k] = scores[psi[t, k]] + log_emission[t, k]\n\n        # backtrack\n        states = np.zeros(n_trials, dtype=int)\n        states[-1] = np.argmax(log_delta[-1])\n        for t in range(n_trials - 2, -1, -1):\n            states[t] = psi[t + 1, states[t + 1]]\n\n        # convert state indices to zone names\n        zone_labels = np.array([zone_names[s] for s in states])\n\n        # distance from each trial's startpoint to its assigned zone range\n        assigned_lo = zone_ranges[states, 0]\n        assigned_hi = zone_ranges[states, 1]\n        zone_dist = np.maximum(np.maximum(assigned_lo - startpoints, startpoints - assigned_hi), 0)\n        zone_dist[~valid] = np.nan\n\n        results[mouse_id] = {'zone_labels': zone_labels, 'states': states, 'zone_dist': zone_dist}\n\n    return results\n NWB session number matches exp_day directly\n            nwb_filename = f'sub-{subject_id}_ses-{exp_day:02d}_behavior+ophys.nwb'\n            nwb_path = os.path.join(sub_dir, nwb_filename)\n\n            if not os.path.exists(nwb_path):\n                print(f\"  WARNING: {nwb_path} not found, skipping\")\n                continue\n\n            result = process_session(nwb_path, subject_id, scene, exp_day)\n            if result is None:\n                continue\n\n            all_neural.append(result['neural'])\n            all_input.append(result['input'])\n            all_output.append(result['output'])\n            all_subject_idx.append(sub_idx)\n            all_brain_region_idx.append(\n                np.zeros(result['n_neurons'], dtype=int)  # all CA1\n            )\n            session_info.append({\n                'subject': subject_id,\n                'exp_day': exp_day,\n                'scene': scene,\n                'imaging_rate': result['imaging_rate'],\n            })\n\n    # Compute median time bin size across all sessions\n    time_bin_sizes = []\n    for info in session_info:\n        time_bin_sizes.append(1000.0 / info['imaging_rate'])\n    median_time_bin = np.median(time_bin_sizes) if time_bin_sizes else 64.5\n\n    data = {\n        'neural': all_neural,\n        'input': all_input,\n        'output': all_output,\n        'subjects': subjects,\n        'subject_idx': np.array(all_subject_idx),\n        'brain_regions': ['CA1'],\n        'brain_region_idx': all_brain_region_idx,\n        'input_names': [\n            'time_from_trial_start',\n            'environment_type',\n            'trial_number',\n            'previous_trial_outcome',\n        ],\n        'output_names': [\n            'distance_to_reward_zone',\n            'absolute_position',\n            'speed',\n            'lick',\n            'reward_zone_location',\n            'reward_outcome',\n        ],\n        'output_values': [\n            ['< -50 cm', '-50 to -10 cm', '-10 to 0 cm', 'in zone', '0 to +10 cm', '+10 to +50 cm', '> +50 cm'],\n            ['0-90 cm', '90-180 cm', '180-270 cm', '270-360 cm', '360-450 cm'],\n            ['< 2 cm/s', '2-10 cm/s', '10-20 cm/s', '20-40 cm/s', '> 40 cm/s'],\n            ['no lick', 'lick'],\n            ['A', 'B', 'C'],\n            ['no reward', 'reward'],\n        ],\n        'metadata': {\n            'task_description': 'Virtual reality hidden reward zone navigation task with reward zone switches across two environments. Mice traverse a 450 cm linear track and lick to receive reward in a hidden 50 cm zone.',\n            'time_bin_size': median_time_bin,\n            'temporal_alignment_event': 'start of trial (first imaging frame after teleport)',\n            'off_start': 0.0,\n            'off_end': None,\n            'session_info': session_info,\n            'track_length_cm': 450,\n            'reward_zones': {'A': [80, 130], 'B': [200, 250], 'C': [320, 370]},\n        },\n    }\n\n    output_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), 'converted_data.pkl')\n    with open(output_path, 'wb') as f:\n        pickle.dump(data, f)\n    print(f\"\\nSaved converted data to {output_path}\")\n    print(f\"  {len(all_neural)} sessions, {len(subjects)} subjects\")\n    for i, sub in enumerate(subjects):\n        n_sess = sum(1 for idx in all_subject_idx if idx == i)\n        print(f\"  {sub}: {n_sess} sessions\")\n\n\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    main()\n","exit_code":0,"status":"completed"}}

156\t    smoothed = gaussian_filter1d(arr_filled, sigma, axis=axis)\n   157\t    # normalize by the fraction of valid data\n   158\t    ones = np.ones_like(arr)\n   159\t    ones[nan_mask] = 0\n   160\t    norm = gaussian_filter1d(ones, sigma, axis=axis)\n   161\t    norm[norm == 0] = 1\n   162\t    result = smoothed / norm\n   163\t    result[nan_mask] = np.nan\n   164\t    return result\n   165\t\n   166\t\n   167\tdef compute_dff_and_deconvolve(F, Fneu, trial_starts, trial_ends, frame_rate, n_planes=1):\n   168\t    \"\"\"\n   169\t    Compute dF/F and deconvolved activity following the paper's pipeline.\n   170\t\n   171\t    Steps:\n   172\t    1. Mask to only include within-trial data (exclude teleport periods)\n   173\t    2. Neuropil subtraction: F - 0.7 * Fneu\n   174\t    3. Per-trial maximin baseline\n   175\t    4. dF/F = (F_corr - baseline) / |baseline|\n   176\t    5. Smooth with 2-sample Gaussian\n   177\t    6. OASIS deconvolution (tau=0.7)\n   178\t    \"\"\"\n   179\t    n_cells, n_frames = F.shape\n   180\t\n   181\t    # Initialize with NaN (teleport periods will remain NaN)\n   182\t    f_ = np.full((n_cells, n_frames), np.nan)\n   183\t\n   184\t    # Copy only within-trial data\n   185\t    for start, stop in zip(trial_starts, trial_ends):\n   186\t        f_[:, start:stop] = F[:, start:stop]\n   187\t\n   188\t    f_neu_ = np.full((n_cells, n_frames), np.nan)\n   189\t    for start, stop in zip(trial_starts, trial_ends):\n   190\t        f_neu_[:, start:stop] = Fneu[:, start:stop]\n   191\t\n   192\t    # Neuropil subtraction\n   193\t    nanmask = ~np.isnan(f_[0, :])\n   194\t    f_[:, nanmask] = f_[:, nanmask] - NEU_COEF * f_neu_[:, nanmask]\n   195\t\n   196\t    # Add back neuropil mean per trial (as in the paper's code)\n   197\t    # and compute baseline\n   198\t    flow = np.full((n_cells, n_frames), np.nan)\n   199\t    for start, stop in zip(trial_starts, trial_ends):\n   200\t        # Add back neuropil mean per trial so dF/F values are reasonable\n   201\t        f_[:, start:stop] = f_[:, start:stop] + NEU_COEF * np.nanmean(\n   202\t            f_neu_[:, start:stop], axis=1, keepdims=True\n   203\t        )\n   204\t        # Maximin baseline\n   205\t        flow[:, start:stop] = nansmooth(f_[:, start:stop], BASELINE_SMOOTH_SIGMA, axis=1)\n   206\t        flow[:, start:stop] = minimum_filter1d(flow[:, start:stop], BASELINE_WINDOW, axis=-1)\n   207\t        flow[:, start:stop] = maximum_filter1d(flow[:, start:stop], BASELINE_WINDOW, axis=-1)\n   208\t\n   209\t    # Compute dF/F\n   210\t    dff = np.full((n_cells, n_frames), np.nan)\n   211\t    dff[:, nanmask] = (f_[:, nanmask] - flow[:, nanmask]) / np.abs(flow[:, nanmask])\n   212\t\n   213\t    # Smooth dF/F and deconvolve per trial\n   214\t    spks = np.full((n_cells, n_frames), np.nan)\n   215\t    for start, stop in zip(trial_starts, trial_ends):\n   216\t        dff[:, start:stop] = nansmooth(dff[:, start:stop], DFF_SMOOTH_SIGMA, axis=1)\n   217\t        spks[:, start:stop] = dcnv.oasis(\n   218\t            dff[:, start:stop], 2000, TAU, frame_rate / n_planes\n   219\t        )\n   220\t\n   221\t    return dff, spks\n   222\t\n   223\t\n   224\tdef get_reward_zone_for_trial(scene, trial_idx, n_trials, change_trial=30):\n   225\t    \"\"\"\n   226\t    Determine the reward zone label for a given trial based on the scene name.\n   227\t    Returns 'A', 'B', or 'C'.\n   228\t    \"\"\"\n   229\t    # Single zone sessions\n   230\t    if 'LocationA' in scene and '_to_' not in scene and '_to_Env' not in scene.split('Location')[-1]:\n   231\t        return 'A'\n   232\t    if 'LocationB' in scene and '_to_' not in scene and '_to_Env' not in scene.split('Location')[-1]:\n   233\t        return 'B'\n   234\t    if 'LocationC' in scene and '_to_' not in scene and '_to_Env' not in scene.split('Location')[-1]:\n   235\t        return 'C'\n   236\t\n   237\t    # Switch sessions - parse zone before and after switch\n   238\t    # Handle cross-environment switches like 'Env1_C_to_Env2_B'\n   239\t    if '_to_Env' in scene:\n   240\t        # e.g. 'Env1_C_to_Env2_B' -> before='C', after='B'\n   241\t        parts = scene.split('_to_')\n   242\t        before_zone = parts[0].split('_')[-1]  # last char before _to_\n   243\t        after_zone = parts[1].split('_')[-1]  # last char\n   244\t    elif '_to_' in scene:\n   245\t        # e.g. 'Env1_LocationA_to_B' -> before='A', after='B'\n   246\t        parts = scene.split('_to_')\n   247\t        before_zone = parts[0].split('Location')[-1]\n   248\t        after_zone = parts[1]\n   249\t    else:\n   250\t        # Shouldn't happen\n   251\t        return 'A'\n   252\t\n   253\t    if trial_idx < change_trial:\n   254\t        return before_zone\n   255\t    else:\n   256\t        return after_zone\n   257\t\n   258\t\n   259\tdef get_environment(scene):\n   260\t    \"\"\"Return 0 for Env1, 1 for Env2.\"\"\"\n","exit_code":0,"status":"completed"}}

  304\t        np.where(position > rz_end, position - rz_end, 0.0)\n   305\t    )\n   306\t    bins = np.zeros(len(dist), dtype=int)\n   307\t    bins[dist < -50] = 0\n   308\t    bins[(dist >= -50) & (dist < -10)] = 1\n   309\t    bins[(dist >= -10) & (dist < 0)] = 2\n   310\t    bins[dist == 0] = 3  # inside zone\n   311\t    bins[(dist > 0) & (dist <= 10)] = 4\n   312\t    bins[(dist > 10) & (dist <= 50)] = 5\n   313\t    bins[dist > 50] = 6\n   314\t    return bins\n   315\t\n   316\t\n   317\tdef discretize_position(position):\n   318\t    \"\"\"Discretize position into 5 equal bins spanning 450 cm.\"\"\"\n   319\t    bins = np.clip((position / 90).astype(int), 0, 4)\n   320\t    return bins\n   321\t\n   322\t\n   323\tdef discretize_speed(speed):\n   324\t    \"\"\"Discretize speed into bins.\"\"\"\n   325\t    bins = np.zeros(len(speed), dtype=int)\n   326\t    bins[speed < 2] = 0\n   327\t    bins[(speed >= 2) & (speed < 10)] = 1\n   328\t    bins[(speed >= 10) & (speed < 20)] = 2\n   329\t    bins[(speed >= 20) & (speed < 40)] = 3\n   330\t    bins[speed >= 40] = 4\n   331\t    return bins\n   332\t\n   333\t\n   334\tdef rz_label_to_idx(label):\n   335\t    \"\"\"Map reward zone label to index: A=0, B=1, C=2.\"\"\"\n   336\t    return {'A': 0, 'B': 1, 'C': 2}[label]\n   337\t\n   338\t\n   339\tdef process_session(nwb_path, subject_id, scene, exp_day):\n
